_comment: Verdicts both verifiers must give riptide's boot (riptide-eventlog.json, apps/fleetd/attest/testdata/riptide-eventlog.bin) under the talos profile for a running node, with each case's keys replacing the profile's. apps/fleetd/attest/keylime_test.go and test_lolwtf_mb_policy.py both assert every case.

cases.name: riptide passes the running node's profile
intake's HookOS requirement is not met by a disk boot
expect: The boot path lacks FML HookOS Secure Boot

cases.name: a db entry the profile does not know
expect: db holds FML Secure Boot, which the policy does not allow

cases.name: a required db entry the firmware lacks
the wrong platform key
expect: PK holds FML Secure Boot, which the policy does not allow
PK lacks Microsoft Corporation KEK CA 2011

cases.name: a KEK entry the profile does not allow
expect: KEK holds Microsoft Corporation KEK 2K CA 2023, which the policy does not allow
KEK holds Microsoft Corporation KEK CA 2011, which the policy does not allow

cases.name: the boot authority is not one the profile allows
expect: A boot authority holds FML Secure Boot, which the policy does not allow

cases.name: one boot application is not pinned
expect: PCR 4 records boot application a7aaadd78bbcd9bf1af39ca49fceebba1c386a2e74f652f303fb3c412dcfab4d, which the policy does not list
